saints.name: St. Peter Claver
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: A Spanish Jesuit at Cartagena who called himself “the slave of the slaves” and served the Africans of the slave ships…
biography: Peter Claver, a Catalan Jesuit, was sent to Cartagena in present-day Colombia, then a chief port of the slave trade. For nearly forty years he met the ships as they arrived, going down into the holds with food, medicine, and the Gospel, baptizing and defending the captives; he signed himself “Peter Claver, slave of the slaves forever.”
Worn out and neglected in his last years, he died in 1654. He is a patron of missions among African peoples.
saints.knownFor: His lifelong service to enslaved Africans at Cartagena.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 9 September
